purpose: The fitting pool for the per-type temperature (roadmap item 1.1b): 500 items of every question type, drawn from the jev-bench VALIDATION split, with the per-config counts and the seed fixed here so the run is reproducible. The data itself stays outside the repository.

go_emotions.quote: The GitHub repository which houses this dataset has an [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/LICENSE).
go_emotions.owes: the Apache notice with the copy; nothing else

banking77.owes: name the mirror (MIT) and the upstream (jev-bench records cc-by-4.0, PolyAI) in the model card

paws.quote: The dataset may be freely used for any purpose, although acknowledgement of Google LLC ("Google") as the data source would be appreciated.

boolq.quote: BoolQ is released under the [Creative Commons Share-Alike 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) license.
boolq.owes: share-alike on a derived WORK. A fitted temperature is one number per question type and carries no boolq text, so the conservative share-alike rule (the licence record 5.2, which keeps share-alike data out of a released ADAPTER) does not bite. The 80 items are here because the pool's counts are fixed by the roadmap item; swapping them for 80 more paws items is a one-line change here, before any compute.
boolq.note: the same category as arc_challenge (cc-by-sa-4.0), which the pool excludes
